channel.title: The Bramblewood Gazette
channel.description: A fictional local newspaper, used as a worked example for a feed source.

item.title: Harbour footbridge reopens after two-year refit
item.description: The eastern span carries pedestrians and cyclists again, with the long detour through Quay Street finally lifted.

item.title: Tramway extension reaches Bramblewood Fields
item.description: Services begin in April, adding four stops and cutting the journey from the northern estates to roughly eleven minutes.

item.title: Central library returns to seven-day opening
item.description: Sunday hours resume for the first time since the refurbishment, alongside a restored evening timetable on weekdays.

item.title: Sponsored: replace your windows before the autumn
item.description: A message from a local glazing firm. Book a survey this month and the call-out fee is waived.

item.title: Bramblewood Almanac: a reader’s guide to the spring markets
item.description: Where to find the seasonal stalls, which days are busiest, and what the weather is likely to do to the outdoor pitches.
